status_note: Headline BTC Deep Backtest reproduced (2 poll-to-stable runs agree). Cost sensitivity A/B/C measured (poll-to-stable); funding estimated analytically. By-year/side/duration/exit-reason tables and walk-forward still PENDING.

candidate.note: Frozen public baseline. Slim harness reproduces the original RiskBased baseline to the cent.

configuration.initial_capital_note: Tester Properties=1000 overrides script=100; % metrics are scale-invariant (risk/equity-relative sizing).

result_scope: BTC, both-sides (long+short), in-sample. Cross-asset NOT verified for this pack. Headline A is commission-only.
reproducibility_rule: After every symbol switch / source update / compile / deep run, poll headline metrics AND trade count until two consecutive reads agree before recording. Otherwise mark INVALID and discard. Deep results read from Strategy Tester DOM.
public_repo_safety_rule: No private Pine source, signal thresholds, risk-% value, leverage cap, core/runner split, secrets, webhook URLs, account IDs, or API keys in this repository.

recommended_public_headline.reason: MEASURED (not estimated), realistic (Binance taker + conservative slippage). Commission-only A over-promises; funding is estimated so it cannot be the headline number itself but must travel alongside as a haircut.
recommended_public_headline.must_disclose: Adding estimated perpetual funding brings realistic all-in to ~+375% to +450% (CAGR ~27-30%/yr). In-sample BTC; cross-asset unverified.

funding_estimate.status: ESTIMATED, not measured (TradingView has no funding model)

caveats: Headline A is in-sample BTC, both-sides, commission-only. It is a backtest figure, NOT an expected live return.
Realistic costs take a ~40% central bite (range ~22-52%): commission-only +623.91% -> measured +slippage +518.40% -> estimated all-in ~+375% (central) to +450%.
Cross-asset edge collapses (documented overfitting): ETH/SOL PF ~1.2. Treat as a BTC-specific result; cross-asset NOT verified for this pack.
Funding is ESTIMATED analytically; only A/B/C net/DD/PF are measured.
Scenario A attribution tables/charts are generated from the exported trade list and are descriptive, not walk-forward recomputation or the recommended cost-adjusted headline.
